role: class of a formula under semantic equivalence
notes: Equivalence class of a CPL formula modulo the semantic relation of Section sec:prop-syntax-semantics-02; local to this section and distinct from the Henkin term class [t].

Exact source notation of Kleene 1952, section 26, Theorem 6, p. 116: tilde is Kleene's object-language equivalence connective, turnstile is his deducibility relation, C_A is a formula with a specified occurrence of A and C_B the result of replacing that occurrence by B. Used only when reporting that source; not the handbook's semantic equivalence.
